response: Yes, receipt of hospice care in nursing homes has been shown to improve the management of pain at the end of life. Studies have consistently found that nursing home residents who receive hospice care experience better pain management, as well as improved symptom control and quality of life, compared to those who do not receive hospice care. Hospice care provides specialized care and support to individuals with terminal illnesses, focusing on comfort, dignity, and quality of life, which includes effective pain management.
